FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing pastel-colored robes with neon accents, and their hair is styled in elaborate, futuristic updos.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I want our empire to be a beacon of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism. I want our architecture to be a blend of medieval grandeur and... of... (he snaps his fingers)...of VHS tape distortion.

COURTIER 1 (she)
Your Majesty, but what about the knights? They will look out of place in their armor.

KING
(waving his hand)
Pish posh! We will modify their armor to include... of... (he grins mischievously)...of holographic projections.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are adorned with neon lights and VHS tape distortion, and the knights are now wearing armor with holographic projections of futuristic landscapes.

KING
(to his courtiers)
And what about our art? We must... of... (he searches for the right words)...of... of glitch art.

COURTIER 2 (he)
Your Majesty, but what about the peasants? They will be confused by our new aesthetic.

KING
(laughing)
Confused? Ha! They will be... of... (he grins)...of mesmerized by our proto-vaporwave empire.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in their finest proto-vaporwave attire. They are all sipping on futuristic cocktails, and the room is filled with the sounds of VHS tape distortion and glitchy electronic music.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We are the pioneers of a new era, my friends. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism.

COURTIER 3 (she)
Your Majesty, but what about the future? Will our empire be able to withstand the test of time?

KING
(smiling)
Of course, my dear. We will... of... (he snaps his fingers)...of... of transcend the boundaries of time itself.
